![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The checks in `validateQuestionRuntimePayloadArtifactAdapter` are not defined in strict byte-order (alphabetical order) by ID. Defining them in alphabetical order ensures consistency and aligns with the package validator rules to prevent diff churn.

```javascript
  const checks = [
    check(allRuntimeRowsObservable, "all_3530_source_map_observed", {
      runtime_source_map_rows: runtimeSourceMapRows,
    }),
    check(allCandidatesValidate, "candidate_payloads_validate"),
    check(deterministicCandidateSelection, "deterministic_candidate_selection"),
    check(forbiddenRemoteDependenciesAbsent, "forbidden_remote_dependencies_absent"),
    check(missingSemanticKgDegradesWithoutRowDrop, "missing_semantic_kg_degrades_without_row_drop"),
    check(noCriticalInputDiagnostics, "no_critical_input_diagnostics"),
    check(requiredArtifactsLoaded, "required_source_artifacts_loaded"),
    check(hashesRecorded, "source_artifact_hashes_recorded"),
  ];
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. For validator scripts, aggregate all input-related errors (such as missing, parse, input-shape, or read errors) into a single validation check (e.g., `input_artifacts_valid`) to ensure the validator fails closed deterministically, and sort the emitted checks lexicographically by their identifier/code to prevent diff churn.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The unit tests should assert the exact list of expected check IDs, verify they are emitted in strict byte-order, and ensure all checks pass.

```javascript
    expect(first.validatorResult.validator_status).toBe("pass");
    expect(first.validatorResult.checks.map((c) => c.id)).toEqual([
      "all_3530_source_map_observed",
      "candidate_payloads_validate",
      "deterministic_candidate_selection",
      "forbidden_remote_dependencies_absent",
      "missing_semantic_kg_degrades_without_row_drop",
      "no_critical_input_diagnostics",
      "required_source_artifacts_loaded",
      "source_artifact_hashes_recorded",
    ]);
    expect(first.validatorResult.checks.every((c) => c.status === "pass")).toBe(true);
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When writing unit tests for package validators, assert the exact list of expected check IDs, verify they are emitted in strict byte-order, and ensure all checks pass.
</details>

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The checks in the readback markdown file should be sorted in strict byte-order (alphabetical order) by ID to match the sorted output of the validator.

```suggestion
- all_3530_source_map_observed: pass
- candidate_payloads_validate: pass
- deterministic_candidate_selection: pass
- forbidden_remote_dependencies_absent: pass
- missing_semantic_kg_degrades_without_row_drop: pass
- no_critical_input_diagnostics: pass
- required_source_artifacts_loaded: pass
- source_artifact_hashes_recorded: pass
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure that lists of inputs or dependencies in both markdown documentation and corresponding JSON artifacts are sorted lexicographically (matching the LC_ALL=C sort contract) to maintain consistency and prevent diff churn.
</details>
Fixed in 9935822df. Validator checks now use a byte-order comparator and are emitted in lexicographic ID order.
Fixed in 9935822df. Added a malformed-input fail-closed regression covering critical diagnostics, invalid runtimeSourceMap row shape, and malformed sourceArtifacts validation without throwing.
Fixed in 9935822df. The adapter test now asserts the exact check IDs, verifies the emitted order is sorted, and asserts every check passes on the happy path.
Fixed in 9935822df. Regenerated question-runtime-payload-artifact-adapter.validator-result.v1.json with checks sorted by ID.
